Triage first-touch grade: **closed `not_planned`** (triage seat, session `session_01NYoiJGd1MxXdcvM4EGAMrS`; reopening is free and is the veto).

The question this card parks — should action/bulk param dialogs feed `dependentValues` to the widget-hint picker class — has zero measured pull: all three surfaces deliberately exclude it, consistently, and nobody has hit the gap. Since it was filed, the premise also improved: #4770 closed via PR #4789, so the allow-table is now ONE exported constant in `@object-ui/fields` rather than three private copies — the "现状只存在于三份注释里" hazard is gone, and any future wiring decision is a one-place change. Declaring a formal contract for a capability nobody is pulling on is declare-and-maintain weight the startup-scope axis says not to buy.

Reopen trigger: a real use case needs `filter-condition` / `recipient-picker` / lookup-filter params inside an action or bulk dialog — at that point the decision is live, and it starts from the single shared constant.
